actions.label: Attack (melee)
actions.description: Strike a target at close range.

actions.label: Attack (ranged)
actions.description: Attack a target from a distance.

actions.label: Natural attack
actions.description: Strike with the actor's body or an innate weapon.

actions.label: Grapple
actions.description: Seize, restrain, or reposition a nearby target.

actions.label: Control
actions.description: Disrupt a foe or shape the immediate battlefield.

actions.label: Defend
actions.description: Brace, block, or parry an incoming threat.

actions.label: Evade
actions.description: Avoid a threat through movement or positioning.

actions.label: Influence
actions.description: Persuade, reassure, command, or negotiate with someone.

actions.label: Deceive
actions.description: Mislead someone through words or behavior.

actions.label: Intimidate
actions.description: Pressure someone through threat, presence, or leverage.

actions.label: Empathize
actions.description: Understand or respond to another character's emotions.

actions.label: Provoke
actions.description: Bait someone into revealing or doing something.

actions.label: Barter
actions.description: Trade value, favors, or terms with someone.

actions.label: Observe
actions.description: Study immediately visible or audible details.

actions.label: Search
actions.description: Examine a person or place for something concealed.

actions.label: Track
actions.description: Follow traces left by a creature, object, or event.

actions.label: Navigate
actions.description: Find or maintain a route through uncertain terrain.

actions.label: Scout
actions.description: Reconnoiter ahead while managing exposure and risk.

actions.label: Decipher
actions.description: Interpret unfamiliar signs, systems, or evidence.

actions.label: Craft
actions.description: Create a useful object from available materials.

actions.label: Repair
actions.description: Restore a damaged object or structure to use.

actions.label: Modify
actions.description: Alter an existing object for a new purpose.

actions.label: Harvest
actions.description: Gather useful material from the surroundings.

actions.label: Concoct
actions.description: Prepare a compound, meal, remedy, or mixture.

actions.label: Dismantle
actions.description: Take something apart safely or purposefully.

actions.label: Move
actions.description: Change position in the current scene.

actions.label: Interact
actions.description: Manipulate an object or environmental feature.

actions.label: Use item
actions.description: Use an owned item for its intended purpose.

actions.label: Assist
actions.description: Help another character with their immediate action.

actions.label: Recover
actions.description: Catch breath or tend to an immediate condition.

actions.label: Wait
actions.description: Hold position and allow the scene to advance.
